title: AI Engineer

nodes.title: Python & Numerical Foundations for AI
nodes.subtitle: NumPy arrays, vector operations, matrix multiplication, broadcasting, PyTorch tensors
learning_objectives: Perform high-speed tensor operations and understand multi-dimensional array shapes
Implement basic linear algebra concepts (dot products, norms) in PyTorch
feynman_prompts: Why are tensor operations significantly faster when executed on GPUs compared to CPUs?
key_misconceptions: Reshaping tensors incorrectly, causing silent dimension mismatch errors

nodes.title: Mathematics for AI: Linear Algebra & Probability
nodes.subtitle: Vectors, matrices, eigenvalues, dot products, conditional probability, Bayes theorem
learning_objectives: Calculate vector similarities using cosine similarity and dot product mathematics
Apply Bayes Theorem to update probability estimates based on observed evidence
feynman_prompts: How does cosine similarity measure semantic orientation independent of vector magnitude?
key_misconceptions: Confusing vector magnitude (length) with vector direction (semantic orientation)

nodes.title: Neural Network Mechanics & Backpropagation
nodes.subtitle: Perceptrons, activation functions (ReLU, GELU), loss functions, gradient descent, backpropagation
learning_objectives: Explain how the chain rule enables backpropagation to update neural network weights
Select appropriate activation functions and loss functions for specific tasks
feynman_prompts: Explain how gradient descent minimizes loss by iteratively stepping in the opposite direction of the gradient.
key_misconceptions: Thinking neural networks are magic black boxes rather than composed mathematical functions

nodes.title: The Transformer Architecture & Self-Attention
nodes.subtitle: Tokens, embeddings, positional encoding, Scaled Dot-Product Attention, multi-head attention
learning_objectives: Explain step-by-step how Scaled Dot-Product Attention calculates attention weights
Differentiate encoder-only (BERT), decoder-only (GPT), and encoder-decoder (T5) models
feynman_prompts: Why is the self-attention mechanism computationally quadratic O(N^2) with respect to context length?
key_misconceptions: Assuming tokens correspond 1:1 with English words without understanding subword tokenization

nodes.title: LLM Mechanics: Pre-training, Sampling & Inference
nodes.subtitle: Autoregressive generation, next-token prediction, temperature, top-p (nucleus), top-k, KV-cache
learning_objectives: Tune temperature and top-p sampling parameters to control model creativity vs determinism
Explain how the KV-cache dramatically accelerates autoregressive token generation
feynman_prompts: How does the Key-Value (KV) cache prevent redundant recomputation during text generation?
key_misconceptions: Setting temperature to 0 and expecting creative, varied conversational responses

nodes.title: Systematic Prompt Engineering & In-Context Learning
nodes.subtitle: System prompts, Few-Shot prompting, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), output schemas, prompt injection
learning_objectives: Author robust system prompts that elicit structured, accurate LLM responses
Guide complex model reasoning using Few-Shot examples and Chain-of-Thought prompts
feynman_prompts: Why does Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting significantly improve multi-step reasoning accuracy?
key_misconceptions: Allowing raw user input directly into system prompts, exposing applications to prompt injection attacks

nodes.title: Structured LLM Outputs & Schema Enforcement
nodes.subtitle: JSON mode, Pydantic schema validation, Instructor, function calling, constrained decoding
learning_objectives: Enforce strict JSON schema validation on LLM responses using Pydantic
Handle malformed or hallucinated JSON outputs with automatic schema retries
feynman_prompts: Why is grammar-constrained decoding superior to naive prompt asking for 'valid JSON'?
key_misconceptions: Parsing raw LLM text with regular expressions instead of enforcing strict JSON schemas

nodes.title: Vector Embeddings & Semantic Search Mechanics
nodes.subtitle: Embedding models (text-embedding-004), vector spaces, dimensionality, cosine distance
learning_objectives: Generate text embeddings and compute semantic similarity across documents
Evaluate embedding model trade-offs between vector dimensions and search latency
feynman_prompts: Why can two sentences with completely different words have near-identical embedding vectors?
key_misconceptions: Using raw Euclidean distance instead of normalized cosine distance for semantic matching

nodes.title: Vector Databases & Indexing Algorithms (HNSW / IVF)
nodes.subtitle: Vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector), Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN), HNSW, filtering
learning_objectives: Deploy and query high-scale vector indexes using pgvector or Qdrant
Tune Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) parameters (M, efConstruction) for speed vs recall
feynman_prompts: How does HNSW achieve sub-linear Approximate Nearest Neighbor search across millions of vectors?
key_misconceptions: Performing brute-force exact cosine searches across millions of vectors in production

nodes.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Ingestion & Chunking
nodes.subtitle: Document parsing (PDFs, Markdown), chunking strategies (recursive, semantic), overlap
learning_objectives: Design document ingestion pipelines with optimal chunk size and sliding overlap
Compare fixed-character chunking with semantic and structural markdown chunking
feynman_prompts: Why does setting chunk sizes too small destroy context while setting them too large dilutes embeddings?
key_misconceptions: Splitting documents by naive character counts that cut words and sentences in half

nodes.title: Advanced RAG: Hybrid Search, Query Rewriting & Reranking
nodes.subtitle: Hybrid search (BM25 + vector), Cross-Encoders / Cohere Rerank, query expansion, HyDE
learning_objectives: Implement hybrid search combining dense semantic vectors with sparse BM25 keyword matching
Re-rank retrieved document candidates using a high-precision Cross-Encoder model
feynman_prompts: Why does hybrid search (semantic + keyword) solve the domain-specific vocabulary problem in RAG?
key_misconceptions: Relying exclusively on vector search for exact keyword queries like serial numbers or function names

nodes.title: Autonomous AI Agents & Function / Tool Calling
nodes.subtitle: Tool definitions, ReAct framework (Reason + Act), multi-step planning, error recovery
learning_objectives: Build autonomous AI agents capable of calling external APIs and databases to answer queries
Implement the ReAct loop allowing agents to reason, execute tools, observe outputs, and self-correct
feynman_prompts: How does an AI model decide which tool to call based on tool descriptions and JSON schemas?
key_misconceptions: Giving agents unconstrained write permissions to production databases without human confirmation

nodes.title: Agentic Orchestration: LangChain & LangGraph
nodes.subtitle: Stateful agent workflows, LangGraph cyclical graphs, human-in-the-loop, memory persistence
learning_objectives: Orchestrate complex multi-agent workflows using stateful cyclical graphs with LangGraph
Implement human-in-the-loop breakpoints for critical agent decisions
feynman_prompts: Why are cyclical state machines superior to simple linear chains for complex agent tasks?
key_misconceptions: Building fragile 1,000-line prompt chains instead of modular, stateful agent graphs

nodes.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs: PEFT, LoRA & QLoRA
nodes.subtitle: Full fine-tuning vs Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), LoRA rank matrices, 4-bit quantization (QLoRA)
learning_objectives: Fine-tune open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral) on custom domain datasets using QLoRA
Evaluate when to use RAG vs Fine-Tuning (RAG for knowledge retrieval, Fine-Tuning for style/format)
feynman_prompts: Why does LoRA freeze base model weights and only train low-rank adapter matrices?
key_misconceptions: Attempting to use fine-tuning to inject fast-changing dynamic facts instead of using RAG

nodes.title: LLM & RAG Evaluation Frameworks (Ragas / TruLens)
nodes.subtitle: Faithfulness, answer relevance, context recall, context precision, LLM-as-a-Judge
learning_objectives: Quantify RAG pipeline quality using automated metrics (Faithfulness, Context Precision)
Implement continuous evaluation suites using LLM-as-a-Judge with calibrated rubrics
feynman_prompts: What is Faithfulness in RAG evaluation and how does it detect model hallucinations?
key_misconceptions: Evaluating AI applications based on casual subjective impressions instead of automated test datasets

nodes.title: AI Safety, Guardrails & Jailbreak Defense
nodes.subtitle: NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, prompt injection defense, content moderation, PII scrubbing
learning_objectives: Implement input and output guardrails to detect and block prompt injection and jailbreaks
Scrub personal identifiable information (PII) from user queries before calling external LLMs
feynman_prompts: How do indirect prompt injection attacks compromise agents that read external web pages or emails?
key_misconceptions: Assuming system prompt instructions alone are sufficient to prevent determined jailbreak attacks

nodes.title: Production LLM Serving & Inference Optimization
nodes.subtitle: vLLM, PagedAttention, continuous batching, quantization (AWQ, GGUF), Tensor Parallelism
learning_objectives: Deploy high-throughput open-source LLM inference servers using vLLM
Explain how PagedAttention eliminates memory fragmentation in GPU VRAM during serving
feynman_prompts: How does continuous batching achieve 10x higher serving throughput compared to static batching?
key_misconceptions: Deploying LLMs using basic HuggingFace pipeline() methods in production web servers

nodes.title: LLM Observability, Caching & Cost Engineering
nodes.subtitle: Semantic caching (GPTCache), token usage tracking, LangSmith / OpenInference, fallback models
learning_objectives: Implement semantic caching to return sub-50ms responses for recurring user queries
Track real-time token spend and latency percentiles using LangSmith / OpenInference
feynman_prompts: How does semantic prompt caching save API token costs for common user inquiries?
key_misconceptions: Using expensive flagship models (e.g. Claude 3.5 Opus) for trivial classification tasks where small models suffice

description: Master AI Engineer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
